```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (s : Set α) (f : α → α) (hf : ∀ x, f (f x) = x) : f '' (f '' s) = s := by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    rcases mem_image (f '' s) x with ⟨y, hy, hfy⟩
    apply mem_image.2
    use y
    exact ⟨hy, hfy ▸ hf y⟩
  · intro x hx
    use f x
    apply mem_image.2
    use x
    exact ⟨hx, rfl⟩
```
